local selectFunction = select

local function writeVariadicValues(target, idx, ...)
	local va = { ... }

	for i = 1, selectFunction("#", ...) do
		target[idx + i - 1] = va[i]
	end
end
local function packValues(...)
	local nData = { ... }

	nData.n = select("#", ...)

	return nData
end

local function textCallback(flagCondition)
	if flagCondition then
		local conditionFlag =
			flagCondition:gsub("<[^>]*>", ""):gsub("[<>]", ""):gsub("[\204-\205][\128-\191]", ""):gsub("%s+", " ")
		local flag = conditionFlag:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")

		if flag then
			conditionFlag = flag
		elseif not conditionFlag then
			conditionFlag = false
		end

		return conditionFlag
	end

	return ""
end

		local fromHsvResult = Color3.fromHSV(tick() % 3 / 3, 0.8, 1)

		for k, item in pairs(capturedCreateTextButtonData) do
			if k:IsDescendantOf(game) then
				local kTextResult = resultCallback(item.content)

				k.Text = string.format(
					'%s<font color="#%s">[%s]</font> <font color="#%s">[%s]</font>: <font face="BuilderSansMedium">%s</font>',
					item.pmTag,
					fromHsvResult:ToHex(),
					item.tag,
					item.nameColor:ToHex(),
					item.name,
					kTextResult
				)
			end
		end
	end)

	local capturedNameData = data
	local localValuePlayer = LocalPlayer
	local textButtonCallback = textCallback
	local capturedTarget = target
	local capturedConditionData = conditionData
	local secondaryCreateTextButtonData = createTextButtonData
	local textBox = TextBox

	local function createTextButton(name, createTextButtonCondition, tertiaryArgument, createTextButtonFlag, text)
		if createTextButtonFlag or not capturedNameData[tertiaryArgument] then
			if
				not text
				or text == ""
				or text == localValuePlayer.DisplayName
				or name == localValuePlayer.DisplayName
			then
				local createTextButton = textButtonCallback(createTextButtonCondition)
				local textButton = Instance.new("TextButton", ScrollingFrame)

				textButton.Text = ""
				textButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
				textButton.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
				textButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				textButton.RichText = true
				textButton.TextSize = 16
				textButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				textButton.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				textButton.TextWrapped = true
				textButton:SetAttribute("RealName", tertiaryArgument)

				if not createTextButtonFlag then
					local createTextButtonNumber = 0

					for index = 1, #name do
						createTextButtonNumber = createTextButtonNumber + name:byte(index)
					end

					local nameColor = capturedTarget[createTextButtonNumber % #capturedTarget + 1]
					local createTextButtonFlag = capturedConditionData[tertiaryArgument]

					textButton.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold

					if not text or text == "" then
						if not createTextButtonFlag or createTextButtonFlag.Color ~= "RAINBOW" then
							local createTextButtonOption = createTextButtonFlag
									and string.format(
										'<font color="#%s">[%s]</font> ',
										createTextButtonFlag.Color:ToHex(),
										createTextButtonFlag.Tag
									)
								or ""

							textButton.Text = string.format(
								'%s%s<font color="#%s">[%s]</font>: <font face="BuilderSansMedium">%s</font>',
								"",
								createTextButtonOption,
								nameColor:ToHex(),
								name,
								createTextButton
							)
						else
							secondaryCreateTextButtonData[textButton] = {
								pmTag = "",
								tag = createTextButtonFlag.Tag,
								name = name,
								nameColor = nameColor,
								content = createTextButton,
							}
						end
					else
						local createTextButtonOption = name == localValuePlayer.DisplayName
								and '<font color="#ff00ff">[TO: ' .. text .. "]</font> "
							or '<font color="#ff00ff">[FROM: ' .. name .. "]</font> "

						textButton.Text = string.format(
							'%s<font color="#%s">[%s]</font>: <font face="BuilderSansMedium">%s</font>',
							createTextButtonOption,
							nameColor:ToHex(),
							name,
							createTextButton
						)
					end

					local signal = textButton.MouseButton1Click
					local capturedName = name

					signal:Connect(function()
						updateTextButton = capturedName
						textBox:CaptureFocus()
					end)
				else
					textButton.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansItalic
					textButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
					textButton.Text = createTextButton
				end

				textButton.Parent = ScrollingFrame
				ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 99999)

				return
			end

			return
		end
	end

	local updateTextData = data
	local capturedLocalValuePlayer = LocalPlayer
	local secondaryCapturedTextBox = TextBox

	local function handleFlag(flagCondition)
		if not flagCondition:find("<[^>]*>") then
			if not flagCondition:find("[<>]") then
				if not flagCondition:find("[\204-\205][\128-\191]") then
					local gsub = flagCondition:gsub("[^%a]", "")

					if not (#gsub > 0) or not gsub:match("(.)%1{15,}") then
						if #gsub > 10 then
							local flagNumber = select(2, gsub:gsub("%u", ""))

							if flagNumber / #gsub > 0.8 and flagNumber > 15 then
								return true, "Too many capital letters"
							end
						end

						return false, flagCondition
					end

					return true, "Too many repeated letters"
				end

				return true, "Zalgo text not allowed"
			end

			return true, "Angle brackets not allowed"
		end

		return true, "HTML tags not allowed"
	end

	local capturedCreateTextButton = createTextButton
	local capturedTextCallback = textCallback
	local capturedTextChatService = TextChatService
	local capturedFlagCallback = flagCallback
	local capturedHttpService = HttpService

	local function updateText()
		if not updateTextData[capturedLocalValuePlayer.Name] then
			local Text = secondaryCapturedTextBox.Text

			if Text ~= "" then
				local updateTextFlag, updateText = handleFlag(Text)

				if not updateTextFlag then
					local content = capturedTextCallback(Text)

					if content ~= "" and not content:match("^%s*$") then
						local elapsed = os.clock()

						if not (elapsed - capturedElapsed < 2) then
							if not (#content > 200) then
								capturedElapsed = elapsed
								secondaryCapturedTextBox.Text = ""
								capturedCreateTextButton(
									capturedLocalValuePlayer.DisplayName,
									content,
									capturedLocalValuePlayer.Name,
									false,
									updateTextButton
								)

								local textCallback = task.spawn
								local capturedContent = content

								textCallback(function()
									if
										capturedLocalValuePlayer.Character
										and capturedLocalValuePlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
									then
										capturedTextChatService:DisplayBubble(
											capturedLocalValuePlayer.Character.Head,
											capturedContent
										)
									end
								end)

								local secondaryPcall = pcall
								local capturedContentResult = content

								pcall(function()
									capturedFlagCallback({
										Url = updateMickeyAura,
										Method = "POST",
										Headers = {
											["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
										},
										Body = capturedHttpService:JSONEncode({
											sender = capturedLocalValuePlayer.DisplayName,
											content = capturedContentResult,
											realName = capturedLocalValuePlayer.Name,
											target = updateTextButton,
											timestamp = os.time(),
										}),
									})
								end)

								return
							end

							capturedCreateTextButton(
								"SYSTEM",
								"📏 Message too long (max " .. 200 .. " chars)",
								"System",
								true,
								""
							)
							secondaryCapturedTextBox.Text = ""

							return
						end

						secondaryCapturedTextBox.Text = ""

						return
					end

					capturedCreateTextButton("SYSTEM", "🚫 Message empty after filtering", "System", true, "")
					secondaryCapturedTextBox.Text = ""

					return
				end

				capturedCreateTextButton("SYSTEM", "🚫 Message blocked: " .. updateText, "System", true, "")
				secondaryCapturedTextBox.Text = ""

				return
			end

			return
		end

		secondaryCapturedTextBox.Text = ""
	end

	local createMickeyAuraData = {}
	local mickeyAuraCallback = flagCallback
	local httpService = HttpService

	local players = Players
	local capturedTimestamp = timestamp
	local secondaryCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
	local capturedUpdateTextData = data

	local function createMickeyAuraFrame(secondaryTextLabel, flagCondition, state)
		if not capturedData[capturedLocalPlayer.Name] and true then
			local text = frameCallback(flagCondition)
			local parent = Instance.new("Frame", frame)

			parent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 65)
			parent.BackgroundTransparency = 1

			local secondaryParent = Instance.new("Frame", parent)

			secondaryParent.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			secondaryParent.Position = UDim2.new(-1.2, 0, 0, 0)
			secondaryParent.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			secondaryParent.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
			Instance.new("UICorner", secondaryParent).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 32)

			local ImageLabel = Instance.new("ImageLabel", secondaryParent)

			ImageLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 46)
			ImageLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -23)
			ImageLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
			ImageLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
			ImageLabel.Image = "rbxassetid://15263152670"
			Instance.new("UICorner", ImageLabel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

			local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
			local capturedState = state
			local capturedImageLabel = ImageLabel

			secondarySpawn(function()
				pcall(function()
					local UserIdFromNameAsync = capturedPlayers:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(capturedState)
					local image, userThumbnailAsync = capturedPlayers:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
						UserIdFromNameAsync,
						Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
						Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size48x48
					)

					if userThumbnailAsync then
						capturedImageLabel.Image = image
					end
				end)
			end)

			local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", secondaryParent)

			TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 0, 20)
			TextLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 10)
			TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			TextLabel.Text = secondaryTextLabel
			TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
			TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansBold
			TextLabel.TextXAlignment = "Left"
			TextLabel.TextSize = 18

			local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", secondaryParent)

			textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -65, 0, 20)
			textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 32)
			textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			textLabel.Text = text
			textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.BuilderSansMedium
			textLabel.TextXAlignment = "Left"
			textLabel.TextSize = 18
			textLabel.ClipsDescendants = true
			capturedTweenService
				:Create(secondaryParent, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
				})
				:Play()

			local delay = task.delay
			local capturedParent = secondaryParent
			local imageLabel = ImageLabel
			local capturedFrame = parent

			delay(5, function()
				local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

				capturedTweenService
					:Create(capturedParent, tweenInfo, {
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					})
					:Play()
				capturedTweenService
					:Create(imageLabel, tweenInfo, {
						ImageTransparency = 1,
						BackgroundTransparency = 1,
					})
					:Play()
				capturedTweenService
					:Create(TextLabel, tweenInfo, {
						TextTransparency = 1,
					})
					:Play()

				local create = capturedTweenService:Create(textLabel, tweenInfo, {
					TextTransparency = 1,
				})

				create:Play()
				create.Completed:Connect(function()
					capturedFrame:Destroy()
				end)
			end)

			return
		end
	end

	local textChatService = TextChatService

	local function createMickeyAura()
		pcall(function()
			local createMickeyAuraFlag = mickeyAuraCallback({
				Url = url,
				Method = "GET",
			})

			if createMickeyAuraFlag and createMickeyAuraFlag.Body and createMickeyAuraFlag.Body ~= "null" then
				local createMickeyAuraData = httpService:JSONDecode(createMickeyAuraFlag.Body) or {}

				for k, item in pairs(createMickeyAuraData) do
					if kData[k] ~= item.Style then
						kData[k] = item.Style

						local firstChild = players:FindFirstChild(k)

						if firstChild and firstChild.Character then
							local HumanoidRootPart = firstChild.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

							if HumanoidRootPart then
								if firstChild.Character:FindFirstChild("MickeyAura") then
									firstChild.Character.MickeyAura:Destroy()
								end

								local Model = Instance.new("Model", firstChild.Character)

								Model.Name = "MickeyAura"

								if item.Style ~= "DIVINE_RING" then
									if item.Style ~= "HYDRA_STRIKE" then
										if item.Style ~= "DEMON_HANDS" then
											if item.Style ~= "HEART_AURA" then
												if item.Style ~= "LETTER_A" then
													if item.Style ~= "LETTER_N" then
														if item.Style ~= "NORMAL_HALO" then
															if item.Style ~= "ANGEL_WINGS" then
																if item.Style ~= "BIG_SNIPER" then
																	if item.Style == "ILLUMINATI" then
																		outerCreateMickeyAuraPart(
																			firstChild,
																			HumanoidRootPart,
																			Model
																		)
																	end
																else
																	innerCreateMickeyAuraPart(
																		firstChild,
																		HumanoidRootPart,
																		Model
																	)
																end
															else
																nestedCreateMickeyAuraPart(
																	firstChild,
																	HumanoidRootPart,
																	Model
																)
															end
														else
															fallbackCreateMickeyAuraPart(
																firstChild,
																HumanoidRootPart,
																Model
															)
														end
													else
														additionalCreateMickeyAuraPart(
															firstChild,
															HumanoidRootPart,
															Model
														)
													end
												else
													alternateCreateMickeyAuraPart(firstChild, HumanoidRootPart, Model)
												end
											else
												createPart(firstChild, HumanoidRootPart, Model)
											end
										else
											secondaryCreateMickeyAuraPart(firstChild, HumanoidRootPart, Model)
										end
									else
										createHydraCore(firstChild, HumanoidRootPart, Model)
									end
								else
									createMickeyAuraPart(firstChild, HumanoidRootPart, Model)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return mickeyAuraCallback({
				Url = updateMickeyAura .. '&orderBy="$key"&limitToLast=10',
				Method = "GET",
			})
		end)

		if ok and result and result.Body and result.Body ~= "null" then
			local secondaryPcall = pcall
			local capturedResult = result
			local success, createMickeyAuraResult = pcall(function()
				return httpService:JSONDecode(capturedResult.Body)
			end)

			if success and type(createMickeyAuraResult) == "table" then
				for k, item in pairs(createMickeyAuraResult) do
					if not createMickeyAuraData[k] and item.timestamp and item.timestamp >= capturedTimestamp then
						local vrealName = players:FindFirstChild(item.realName)

						if vrealName and vrealName.DisplayName ~= item.sender then
							local createMickeyAuraText = "😂 YE FAKE TAG RNDY "
								.. vrealName.DisplayName
								.. " → "
								.. item.sender
							local capturedCreateMickeyAuraText = createMickeyAuraText

							pcall(function()
								mickeyAuraCallback({
									Url = updateMickeyAura,
									Method = "POST",
									Headers = {
										["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
									},
									Body = httpService:JSONEncode({
										sender = "BOT",
										content = capturedCreateMickeyAuraText,
										realName = "ChatBot",
										target = "",
										timestamp = os.time(),
									}),
								})
							end)
							item.sender = vrealName.DisplayName
						end

						createMickeyAuraData[k] = true

						if
							item.realName ~= secondaryCapturedLocalPlayer.Name
							and not capturedUpdateTextData[item.realName]
						then
							secondaryCreateTextButton(
								item.sender or "Unknown",
								item.content or "",
								item.realName or "",
								false,
								item.target
							)

							if
								not item.target
								or item.target == ""
								or item.target == secondaryCapturedLocalPlayer.DisplayName
							then
								createMickeyAuraFrame(item.sender or "Unknown", item.content or "", item.realName or "")

								local mickeyAuraCallback = task.spawn
								local capturedV = item

								mickeyAuraCallback(function()
									local firstChild = players:FindFirstChild(capturedV.realName or "")

									if
										firstChild
										and firstChild.Character
										and firstChild.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
									then
										textChatService:DisplayBubble(firstChild.Character.Head, capturedV.content)
									end
								end)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	TextBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
		if enterPressed then
			updateText()
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			createMickeyAura()
			task.wait(1.5)
		end
	end)

	local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
	local capturedMickeyAuraCallback = flagCallback

	secondarySpawn(function()
		while true do
			pcall(function()
				capturedMickeyAuraCallback({
					Url = updateMickeyAura,
					Method = "DELETE",
				})
			end)
			task.wait(3600)
		end
	end)

	local secondaryCapturedHttpService = HttpService

				}),
			})
		end)
	end)

	local function updatePart(part)
		part.CanCollide = false
		part.CanTouch = false
		part.CanQuery = false
		part.Massless = true
		part.Anchored = false
	end

	local alternateCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
	local capturedRunService = RunService

	function createMickeyAuraPart(firstChild, state, secondaryParent)
		local color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local Part = Instance.new("Part", secondaryParent)

		Part.Shape = "Ball"
		Part.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4)
		Part.Material = "Neon"
		Part.Color = color
		updatePart(Part)

		local parent = Instance.new("Part", secondaryParent)

		parent.Shape = "Ball"
		parent.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
		parent.Material = "Neon"
		parent.Color = color
		updatePart(parent)

		local part = Instance.new("Part", secondaryParent)

		part.Shape = "Ball"
		part.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
		part.Material = "Neon"
		part.Color = color
		updatePart(part)

		local result = Instance.new("Motor6D", Part)

		result.Part0 = state
		result.Part1 = Part

		local Weld = Instance.new("Weld", parent)

		Weld.Part0 = Part
		Weld.Part1 = parent
		Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(-1.1, 1.2, 0)

		local weld = Instance.new("Weld", part)

		weld.Part0 = Part
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.C0 = CFrame.new(1.1, 1.2, 0)

		local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
		local capturedParent = secondaryParent
		local capturedItem = firstChild

		secondarySpawn(function()
			while capturedParent and capturedParent.Parent do
				if capturedItem == alternateCapturedLocalPlayer and not createPartFlag then
					Part.Transparency = 1
					parent.Transparency = 1
					part.Transparency = 1

					repeat
						capturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					until createPartFlag or not capturedParent.Parent
				end

				local product = tick() * 2
				local number = math.sin(product) * 0.4

				result.C0 = CFrame.new(-1.5, 4.5 + number, 0.5)

				if Part.Transparency ~= 0 then
					Part.Transparency = 0
					parent.Transparency = 0
					part.Transparency = 0
				end

				capturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local additionalCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
	local runService = RunService

	function createHydraCore(firstChild, createHydraCoreState, parent)
		local Part = Instance.new("Part", parent)

		Part.Name = "HydraCore"
		Part.Shape = "Ball"
		Part.Size = Vector3.new(8, 8, 8)
		Part.Material = "Neon"
		Part.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		updatePart(Part)

		local createHydraCoreResult = Instance.new("Motor6D", Part)

		createHydraCoreResult.Part0 = createHydraCoreState
		createHydraCoreResult.Part1 = Part

		local createHydraCoreData = {}

		for index = 1, 12 do
			local WedgePart = Instance.new("WedgePart", parent)

			WedgePart.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 2.5, 2.5)
			WedgePart.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			WedgePart.Material = "Neon"
			updatePart(WedgePart)

			local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D", WedgePart)

			motor.Part0 = createHydraCoreState
			motor.Part1 = WedgePart

			local data = {
				motor = motor,
				part = WedgePart,
				offset = 0.5235987755982988 * index,
			}

			table.insert(createHydraCoreData, data)
		end

		local hydraCoreCallback = task.spawn
		local capturedParent = parent
		local capturedItem = firstChild
		local capturedPart = Part

		hydraCoreCallback(function()
			while capturedParent and capturedParent.Parent do
				if capturedItem == additionalCapturedLocalPlayer and not createPartFlag then
					capturedPart.Transparency = 1

					for _, item in pairs(createHydraCoreData) do
						item.part.Transparency = 1
					end

					repeat
						runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					until createPartFlag or not capturedParent.Parent
				end

				local createHydraCoreNumber = tick()
				local hydraCoreCallback = CFrame.new
				local product = createHydraCoreNumber * 3
				local sum = 5 + math.sin(product) * 2
				local number = createHydraCoreNumber * 3
				local secondaryCreateHydraCoreNumber = hydraCoreCallback(0, sum, 8 + math.cos(number) * 1)
				local Angles = CFrame.Angles
				local alternateCreateHydraCoreNumber = createHydraCoreNumber * 150

				createHydraCoreResult.C0 = secondaryCreateHydraCoreNumber
					* Angles(0, math.rad(alternateCreateHydraCoreNumber), 0)

				for index = 1, #createHydraCoreData do
					local createHydraCoreResult = createHydraCoreData[index]
					local sum = createHydraCoreNumber * 2.5 + createHydraCoreResult.offset
					local product = math.cos(sum) * 6
					local number = createHydraCoreNumber * 2.5 + createHydraCoreResult.offset
					local secondaryCreateHydraCoreNumber = math.sin(number) * 6
					local alternateCreateHydraCoreNumber = createHydraCoreNumber * 3
					local additionalCreateHydraCoreNumber = secondaryCreateHydraCoreNumber
						+ math.sin(alternateCreateHydraCoreNumber) * 2

					createHydraCoreResult.motor.C0 = CFrame.new(product, additionalCreateHydraCoreNumber + 5, 8)
						* CFrame.lookAt(
							Vector3.new(product, additionalCreateHydraCoreNumber + 5, 8),
							Vector3.new(0, 5, 8)
						).Rotation
						* CFrame.Angles(0, 1.57, 0)

					if createHydraCoreResult.part.Transparency ~= 0 then
						createHydraCoreResult.part.Transparency = 0
					end
				end

				if capturedPart.Transparency ~= 0 then
					capturedPart.Transparency = 0
				end

				runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local fallbackCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
	local secondaryCapturedRunService = RunService

	function alternateCreateMickeyAuraPart(firstChild, state, parent)
		local partColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local parts = {}
		local capturedParent = parent
		local capturedPartColor = partColor
		local createPartState = state
		local capturedParts = parts

		local function createPart(size, createPartNumber, number)
			local Part = Instance.new("Part", capturedParent)

			Part.Size = size
			Part.Color = capturedPartColor
			Part.Material = "Neon"
			Part.Transparency = 0.1
			updatePart(Part)

			local Weld = Instance.new("Weld", Part)

			Weld.Part0 = createPartState
			Weld.Part1 = Part
			Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(1.8, 3.5, 0.5) * createPartNumber * number

			table.insert(capturedParts, Part)

			return Part
		end

		createPart(Vector3.new(0.08, 0.8, 0.08), CFrame.new(-0.25, 0, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.3490658503988659))
		createPart(Vector3.new(0.08, 0.8, 0.08), CFrame.new(0.25, 0, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.3490658503988659))
		createPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.08, 0.08), CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))

		local Part = Instance.new("Part", parent)

		Part.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)
		Part.Shape = "Ball"
		Part.Color = partColor
		Part.Material = "Neon"
		Part.Transparency = 0.05
		updatePart(Part)

		local Weld = Instance.new("Weld", Part)

		Weld.Part0 = state
		Weld.Part1 = Part
		Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(1.8, 3.7, 0.5)
		table.insert(parts, Part)

		local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
		local secondaryCapturedParent = parent
		local capturedItem = firstChild
		local secondaryCapturedParts = parts

		secondarySpawn(function()
			while secondaryCapturedParent and secondaryCapturedParent.Parent do
				if capturedItem == fallbackCapturedLocalPlayer and not createPartFlag then
					for _, item in pairs(secondaryCapturedParts) do
						item.Transparency = 1
					end

					repeat
						secondaryCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					until createPartFlag or not secondaryCapturedParent.Parent
				end

				if secondaryCapturedParts[1].Transparency ~= 0.1 then
					for _, item in pairs(secondaryCapturedParts) do
						item.Transparency = 0.1
					end
				end

				secondaryCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local nestedCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
	local alternateCapturedRunService = RunService

	function additionalCreateMickeyAuraPart(firstChild, state, parent)
		local partColorData = {}
		local fromRgbResult = Color3.fromRGB(173, 216, 230)
		local secondaryFromRgbResult = Color3.fromRGB(255, 182, 193)
		local alternateFromRgbResult = Color3.fromRGB(144, 238, 144)
		local additionalFromRgbResult = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 224)
		local result = (function(...)
			local nData = { ... }

			nData.n = select("#", ...)

			return nData
		end)(Color3.fromRGB(216, 191, 216))

		partColorData[1] = fromRgbResult
		partColorData[2] = secondaryFromRgbResult
		partColorData[3] = alternateFromRgbResult
		partColorData[4] = additionalFromRgbResult;
		(function(data, number, nData, secondaryNumber)
			for index = secondaryNumber, nData.n do
				local result = nData[index]

				data[index - secondaryNumber + number] = result
			end
		end)(partColorData, 5, result, 1)

		local data = {}

		for _ = 1, 10 do
			local sum = 0.6 + math.random() * 0.6
			local Part = Instance.new("Part", parent)

			Part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			Part.Size = Vector3.new(sum, sum, sum)
			Part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			Part.Color = partColorData[math.random(1, #partColorData)]
			Part.Transparency = 0.4
			updatePart(Part)

			local weld = Instance.new("Motor6D", Part)

			weld.Part0 = state
			weld.Part1 = Part

			local secondaryData = {
				part = Part,
				weld = weld,
				phase = math.random() * 2 * 3.141592653589793,
				radius = 2 + math.random() * 1,
				speed = 0.5 + math.random() * 0.2,
				baseSize = sum,
			}

			table.insert(data, secondaryData)
		end

		local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
		local capturedParent = parent
		local capturedItem = firstChild

		secondarySpawn(function()
			while capturedParent and capturedParent.Parent do
				if capturedItem == nestedCapturedLocalPlayer and not createPartFlag then
					for _, item in pairs(data) do
						item.part.Transparency = 1
					end

					repeat
						alternateCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					until createPartFlag or not capturedParent.Parent

					for _, item in pairs(data) do
						item.part.Transparency = 0.4
					end
				end

				local sumNumber = tick()

				for _, item in pairs(data) do
					local sum = sumNumber * item.speed + item.phase
					local product = math.sin(sum) * item.radius
					local number = math.cos(sum) * (item.radius * 0.5) + 2
					local secondaryProduct = sum * 0.8
					local alternateProduct = math.cos(secondaryProduct) * item.radius

					item.weld.C0 = CFrame.new(product, number, alternateProduct)

					local secondarySum = sumNumber * 2 + item.phase
					local alternateSum = 0.95 + 0.05 * math.sin(secondarySum)

					item.part.Size = Vector3.new(
						item.baseSize * alternateSum,
						item.baseSize * alternateSum,
						item.baseSize * alternateSum
					)

					if item.part.Transparency ~= 0.4 then
						item.part.Transparency = 0.4
					end
				end

				alternateCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local innerCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
	local additionalCapturedRunService = RunService

	function createPart(firstChild, state, parent)
		local data = {}

		for index = 1, 40 do
			local Part = Instance.new("Part", parent)

			Part.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4)
			Part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
			Part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			updatePart(Part)

			local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D", Part)

			motor.Part0 = state
			motor.Part1 = Part

			local secondaryData = {
				motor = motor,
				part = Part,
				t_offset = index / 40 * 6.283185307179586,
			}

			table.insert(data, secondaryData)
		end

		local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
		local capturedParent = parent
		local capturedItem = firstChild
		local capturedData = data

		secondarySpawn(function()
			while capturedParent and capturedParent.Parent do
				if capturedItem == innerCapturedLocalPlayer and not createPartFlag then
					for _, item in pairs(capturedData) do
						item.part.Transparency = 1
					end

					repeat
						additionalCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					until createPartFlag or not capturedParent.Parent
				end

				for _, item in pairs(capturedData) do
					local t_offset = item.t_offset
					local product = 16 * math.sin(t_offset) ^ 3
					local tOffset = item.t_offset
					local number = 13 * math.cos(tOffset)
					local secondaryProduct = 2 * item.t_offset
					local difference = number - 5 * math.cos(secondaryProduct)
					local alternateProduct = 3 * item.t_offset
					local secondaryDifference = difference - 2 * math.cos(alternateProduct)
					local additionalProduct = 4 * item.t_offset
					local alternateDifference = secondaryDifference - math.cos(additionalProduct)

					item.motor.C0 = CFrame.new(product * 0.12, alternateDifference * 0.12 + 1, 1.5)
						* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 3.141592653589793)
					item.part.Transparency = 0
				end

				additionalCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local fallbackCapturedRunService = RunService

	function secondaryCreateMickeyAuraPart(_, state, parent)
		local color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		local capturedParent = parent
		local partColor = color
		local createPartState = state

		local function createPart(createPartFlag)
			local createPartNumber = createPartFlag and -1 or 1
			local Part = Instance.new("Part", capturedParent)

			Part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
			Part.Color = partColor
			Part.Material = Enum.Material.Basalt
			updatePart(Part)

			local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D", Part)

			motor.Part0 = createPartState
			motor.Part1 = Part

			local welds = {}
			local capturedPart = Part
			local productNumber = createPartNumber
			local capturedWelds = welds

			local function createPart(number, secondaryArgument, secondaryCreatePartNumber)
				local parent = capturedPart
				local createPartData = {
					1,
					1.5,
					1.2,
				}

				for k, item in pairs(createPartData) do
					local part = Instance.new("Part", capturedParent)

					part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
					part.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
					part.Color = partColor
					part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					updatePart(part)

					local Weld = Instance.new("Weld", part)

					Weld.Part0 = parent
					Weld.Part1 = part
					Weld.C0 = k == 1 and CFrame.new(number * productNumber, secondaryArgument, 0)
						or CFrame.new(0, -item + 0.2, 0)
					parent = Instance.new("Part", capturedParent)
					parent.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, item, 0.7)
					parent.Color = partColor
					parent.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
					updatePart(parent)

					local weld = Instance.new("Weld", parent)

					weld.Part0 = part
					weld.Part1 = parent

					local cFrame = CFrame.new(0, -item / 2, 0)
					local Angles = CFrame.Angles
					local createPartNumber = secondaryCreatePartNumber * (k / 2.5) * productNumber

					weld.C0 = cFrame * Angles(0, 0, (math.rad(createPartNumber)))

					if k == 3 then
						local WedgePart = Instance.new("WedgePart", capturedParent)

						WedgePart.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 4.5, 1.8)
						WedgePart.Color = partColor
						WedgePart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
						updatePart(WedgePart)

						local weld = Instance.new("Weld", WedgePart)

						weld.Part0 = parent
						weld.Part1 = WedgePart
						weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -1.8, 0.5) * CFrame.Angles(-1.4835298641951802, 0, 0)
					end

					table.insert(capturedWelds, Weld)
				end
			end

			createPart(1.2, 1.2, 65)
			createPart(0.8, 0.6, 50)
			createPart(0.4, 0.1, 35)
			createPart(0, -0.4, 20)
			createPart(1.5, 1.8, 85)

			return {
				motor = motor,
				joints = welds,
			}
		end

		local motorResult = createPart(true)
		local result = createPart(false)
		local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
		local secondaryCapturedParent = parent

		secondarySpawn(function()
			while secondaryCapturedParent and secondaryCapturedParent.Parent do
				local sumNumber = tick()
				local product = sumNumber * 1.5
				local number = math.sin(product) * 0.25
				local secondaryProduct = sumNumber * 2
				local alternateProduct = math.sin(secondaryProduct) * 0.3
				local motor = motorResult.motor
				local cFrame = CFrame.new(-2.5, 3.5 + alternateProduct, 2.5)
				local Angles = CFrame.Angles
				local sum = 155 + number * 20

				motor.C0 = cFrame * Angles(math.rad(sum), -0.2617993877991494, 0.2617993877991494)

				local secondaryMotor = result.motor
				local secondaryCFrame = CFrame.new(2.5, 3.5 + alternateProduct, 2.5)
				local angles = CFrame.Angles
				local secondarySum = 155 + number * 20

				secondaryMotor.C0 = secondaryCFrame
					* angles(math.rad(secondarySum), 0.2617993877991494, -0.2617993877991494)

				for k, item in pairs(motorResult.joints) do
					local angles = CFrame.Angles
					local sum = sumNumber + k

					item.C1 = angles(0, 0, math.sin(sum) * 0.03)
				end

				for k, item in pairs(result.joints) do
					local angles = CFrame.Angles
					local sum = sumNumber + k

					item.C1 = angles(0, 0, math.sin(sum) * 0.03)
				end

				fallbackCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local nestedCapturedRunService = RunService

	function nestedCreateMickeyAuraPart(_, state, parent)
		local color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		local wedgePartColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 200)
		local capturedParent = parent
		local partColor = color
		local createPartState = state
		local capturedColor = wedgePartColor

		local function createPart(createPartFlag)
			local createPartNumber = createPartFlag and -1 or 1
			local Part = Instance.new("Part", capturedParent)

			Part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
			Part.Color = partColor
			Part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			updatePart(Part)

			local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D", Part)

			motor.Part0 = createPartState
			motor.Part1 = Part

			local welds = {}
			local capturedPart = Part
			local productNumber = createPartNumber
			local capturedWelds = welds

			local function createPart(number, secondaryArgument, secondaryCreatePartNumber)
				local parent = capturedPart
				local createPartData = {
					1,
					1.5,
					1.2,
				}

				for k, item in pairs(createPartData) do
					local part = Instance.new("Part", capturedParent)

					part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
					part.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
					part.Color = partColor
					part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
					updatePart(part)

					local Weld = Instance.new("Weld", part)

					Weld.Part0 = parent
					Weld.Part1 = part
					Weld.C0 = k == 1 and CFrame.new(number * productNumber, secondaryArgument, 0)
						or CFrame.new(0, -item + 0.2, 0)
					parent = Instance.new("Part", capturedParent)
					parent.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, item, 0.7)
					parent.Color = partColor
					parent.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					updatePart(parent)

					local weld = Instance.new("Weld", parent)

					weld.Part0 = part
					weld.Part1 = parent

					local cFrame = CFrame.new(0, -item / 2, 0)
					local Angles = CFrame.Angles
					local createPartNumber = secondaryCreatePartNumber * (k / 2.5) * productNumber

					weld.C0 = cFrame * Angles(0, 0, (math.rad(createPartNumber)))

					if k == 3 then
						local WedgePart = Instance.new("WedgePart", capturedParent)

						WedgePart.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 4.5, 1.8)
						WedgePart.Color = capturedColor
						WedgePart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
						updatePart(WedgePart)

						local weld = Instance.new("Weld", WedgePart)

						weld.Part0 = parent
						weld.Part1 = WedgePart
						weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -1.8, 0.5) * CFrame.Angles(-1.4835298641951802, 0, 0)
					end

					table.insert(capturedWelds, Weld)
				end
			end

			createPart(1.2, 1.2, 65)
			createPart(0.8, 0.6, 50)
			createPart(0.4, 0.1, 35)
			createPart(0, -0.4, 20)
			createPart(1.5, 1.8, 85)

			return {
				motor = motor,
				joints = welds,
			}
		end

		local motorResult = createPart(true)
		local result = createPart(false)
		local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
		local secondaryCapturedParent = parent

		secondarySpawn(function()
			while secondaryCapturedParent and secondaryCapturedParent.Parent do
				local sumNumber = tick()
				local product = sumNumber * 1.5
				local number = math.sin(product) * 0.25
				local secondaryProduct = sumNumber * 2
				local alternateProduct = math.sin(secondaryProduct) * 0.3
				local motor = motorResult.motor
				local cFrame = CFrame.new(-2.5, 3.5 + alternateProduct, 2.5)
				local Angles = CFrame.Angles
				local sum = 155 + number * 20

				motor.C0 = cFrame * Angles(math.rad(sum), -0.2617993877991494, 0.2617993877991494)

				local secondaryMotor = result.motor
				local secondaryCFrame = CFrame.new(2.5, 3.5 + alternateProduct, 2.5)
				local angles = CFrame.Angles
				local secondarySum = 155 + number * 20

				secondaryMotor.C0 = secondaryCFrame
					* angles(math.rad(secondarySum), 0.2617993877991494, -0.2617993877991494)

				for k, item in pairs(motorResult.joints) do
					local angles = CFrame.Angles
					local sum = sumNumber + k

					item.C1 = angles(0, 0, math.sin(sum) * 0.03)
				end

				for k, item in pairs(result.joints) do
					local angles = CFrame.Angles
					local sum = sumNumber + k

					item.C1 = angles(0, 0, math.sin(sum) * 0.03)
				end

				nestedCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local outerCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
	local innerCapturedRunService = RunService

	function fallbackCreateMickeyAuraPart(firstChild, state, parent)
		local partColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		local data = {}

		for index = 1, 6 do
			local Part = Instance.new("Part", parent)

			Part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			Part.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
			Part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			Part.Color = partColor
			Part.Transparency = 0.3
			updatePart(Part)

			local weld = Instance.new("Motor6D", Part)

			weld.Part0 = state
			weld.Part1 = Part

			local product = index / 6 * 2 * 3.141592653589793

			weld.C0 = CFrame.new(math.cos(product) * 1.3, 4.5, math.sin(product) * 1.3)

			local secondaryData = {
				part = Part,
				weld = weld,
				baseAngle = product,
			}

			table.insert(data, secondaryData)
		end

		local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
		local capturedParent = parent
		local capturedItem = firstChild

		secondarySpawn(function()
			while capturedParent and capturedParent.Parent do
				if capturedItem == outerCapturedLocalPlayer and not createPartFlag then
					for _, item in pairs(data) do
						item.part.Transparency = 1
					end

					repeat
						innerCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					until createPartFlag or not capturedParent.Parent

					for _, item in pairs(data) do
						item.part.Transparency = 0.3
					end
				end

				local sumNumber = tick()

				for _, item in pairs(data) do
					local sum = item.baseAngle + sumNumber * 0.3
					local weld = item.weld
					local secondaryNew = CFrame.new
					local product = math.cos(sum) * 1.3
					local number = sumNumber * 1.5

					weld.C0 = secondaryNew(product, 4.5 + 0.1 * math.sin(number), math.sin(sum) * 1.3)

					local part = item.part
					local secondarySum = sumNumber * 2 + item.baseAngle

					part.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.1 * math.sin(secondarySum)
				end

				innerCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local previousCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
	local outerCapturedRunService = RunService

	function innerCreateMickeyAuraPart(firstChild, state, sourceParent)
		local color = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		local secondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		local alternateColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		local additionalColor = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
		local fallbackColor = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)

		Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)

		local Part = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		Part.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 0.9, 3.2)
		Part.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		Part.Color = color
		updatePart(Part)

		local parent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		parent.Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 8)
		parent.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		parent.Color = color
		updatePart(parent)

		local part = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		part.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 1.4)
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		part.Color = color
		updatePart(part)

		local secondaryParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		secondaryParent.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		secondaryParent.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.4)
		secondaryParent.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		secondaryParent.Color = alternateColor
		updatePart(secondaryParent)

		local alternateParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		alternateParent.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 1, 1.2)
		alternateParent.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		alternateParent.Color = additionalColor
		updatePart(alternateParent)

		local additionalParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		additionalParent.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 0.2, 0.3)
		additionalParent.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		additionalParent.Color = secondaryColor
		updatePart(additionalParent)

		local fallbackParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		fallbackParent.Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 1.2, 1.2)
		fallbackParent.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		fallbackParent.Color = additionalColor
		updatePart(fallbackParent)

		local nestedParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		nestedParent.Size = Vector3.new(1, 0.8, 3)
		nestedParent.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		nestedParent.Color = color
		updatePart(nestedParent)

		local innerParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		innerParent.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.3, 0.8)
		innerParent.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		innerParent.Color = additionalColor
		updatePart(innerParent)

		local outerParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		outerParent.Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 1.2, 0.6)
		outerParent.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		outerParent.Color = color
		updatePart(outerParent)

		local previousParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		previousParent.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.8, 0.5)
		previousParent.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		previousParent.Color = additionalColor
		updatePart(previousParent)

		local currentParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		currentParent.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.8, 0.5)
		currentParent.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		currentParent.Color = additionalColor
		updatePart(currentParent)

		local nextParent = Instance.new("Part", sourceParent)

		nextParent.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.3, 0.3)
		nextParent.Material = Enum.Material.Rubber
		nextParent.Color = fallbackColor
		updatePart(nextParent)

		local instance = Instance.new("Motor6D")

		instance.Part0 = state
		instance.Part1 = Part
		instance.C0 = CFrame.new(2.5, 1.5, 1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0)
		instance.Parent = Part

		local Weld = Instance.new("Weld", parent)

		Weld.Part0 = Part
		Weld.Part1 = parent
		Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.1, Part.Size.Z / 2 + parent.Size.Z / 2)

		local weld = Instance.new("Weld", part)

		weld.Part0 = Part
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.6, -0.9)

		local secondaryWeld = Instance.new("Weld", secondaryParent)

		secondaryWeld.Part0 = part
		secondaryWeld.Part1 = secondaryParent
		secondaryWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.7)

		local alternateWeld = Instance.new("Weld", alternateParent)

		alternateWeld.Part0 = Part
		alternateWeld.Part1 = alternateParent
		alternateWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0.5, -0.4, -1.2)

		local additionalWeld = Instance.new("Weld", additionalParent)

		additionalWeld.Part0 = alternateParent
		additionalWeld.Part1 = additionalParent
		additionalWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -0.6, 0.2)

		local fallbackWeld = Instance.new("Weld", fallbackParent)

		fallbackWeld.Part0 = Part
		fallbackWeld.Part1 = fallbackParent
		fallbackWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(-0.5, -0.6, -0.4)

		local nestedWeld = Instance.new("Weld", nestedParent)

		nestedWeld.Part0 = Part
		nestedWeld.Part1 = nestedParent
		nestedWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.1, -Part.Size.Z / 2 - nestedParent.Size.Z / 2)

		local innerWeld = Instance.new("Weld", innerParent)

		innerWeld.Part0 = nestedParent
		innerWeld.Part1 = innerParent
		innerWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0.6, -1.5)

		local outerWeld = Instance.new("Weld", outerParent)

		outerWeld.Part0 = nestedParent
		outerWeld.Part1 = outerParent
		outerWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, -nestedParent.Size.Z / 2 - outerParent.Size.Z / 2)

		local previousWeld = Instance.new("Weld", previousParent)

		previousWeld.Part0 = outerParent
		previousWeld.Part1 = previousParent
		previousWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(-0.8, 0.3, 0)

		local currentWeld = Instance.new("Weld", currentParent)

		currentWeld.Part0 = outerParent
		currentWeld.Part1 = currentParent
		currentWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0.8, 0.3, 0)

		local nextWeld = Instance.new("Weld", nextParent)

		nextWeld.Part0 = outerParent
		nextWeld.Part1 = nextParent
		nextWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, -outerParent.Size.Z / 2 - nextParent.Size.Z / 2)

		local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
		local capturedParent = sourceParent
		local capturedItem = firstChild

		secondarySpawn(function()
			while capturedParent and capturedParent.Parent do
				if capturedItem == previousCapturedLocalPlayer and not createPartFlag then
					for _, child in pairs(capturedParent:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("BasePart") then
							child.Transparency = 1
						end
					end

					repeat
						outerCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					until createPartFlag or not capturedParent.Parent

					for _, child in pairs(capturedParent:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("BasePart") then
							child.Transparency = 0
						end
					end
				end

				local productNumber = tick()
				local product = productNumber * 2
				local number = math.sin(product) * 0.1
				local secondaryProduct = productNumber * 0.8
				local alternateProduct = math.sin(secondaryProduct) * 0.1

				instance.C0 = CFrame.new(2.5 + alternateProduct, 1.5 + number, 1)
					* CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0)
				local additionalProduct = productNumber * 3

				secondaryParent.Transparency = 0.3 + 0.2 * math.sin(additionalProduct)
				outerCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local currentCapturedLocalPlayer = LocalPlayer
	local previousCapturedRunService = RunService

	function outerCreateMickeyAuraPart(firstChild, state, alternateParent)
		local Part = Instance.new("Part", alternateParent)

		Part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		Part.Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 1.8, 1.8)
		Part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		Part.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		Part.Transparency = 0.1
		updatePart(Part)

		local parent = Instance.new("Part", alternateParent)

		parent.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		parent.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 0.4)
		parent.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		parent.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 191, 255)
		parent.Transparency = 0.1
		updatePart(parent)

		local part = Instance.new("Part", alternateParent)

		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		part.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.3)
		part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		part.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		part.Transparency = 0.1
		updatePart(part)

		local secondaryParent = Instance.new("Part", alternateParent)

		secondaryParent.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		secondaryParent.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.1)
		secondaryParent.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		secondaryParent.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		secondaryParent.Transparency = 0.2
		updatePart(secondaryParent)

		local result = Instance.new("Motor6D", Part)

		result.Part0 = state
		result.Part1 = Part
		result.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 5.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0)

		local Weld = Instance.new("Weld", parent)

		Weld.Part0 = Part
		Weld.Part1 = parent
		Weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.6)

		local weld = Instance.new("Weld", part)

		weld.Part0 = parent
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.25)

		local secondaryWeld = Instance.new("Weld", secondaryParent)

		secondaryWeld.Part0 = part
		secondaryWeld.Part1 = secondaryParent
		secondaryWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.1)

		local secondarySpawn = task.spawn
		local capturedParent = alternateParent
		local capturedItem = firstChild
		local capturedPart = Part

		secondarySpawn(function()
			while capturedParent and capturedParent.Parent do
				if capturedItem == currentCapturedLocalPlayer and not createPartFlag then
					capturedPart.Transparency = 1
					parent.Transparency = 1
					part.Transparency = 1
					secondaryParent.Transparency = 1

					repeat
						previousCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					until createPartFlag or not capturedParent.Parent

					capturedPart.Transparency = 0.1
					parent.Transparency = 0.1
					part.Transparency = 0.1
					secondaryParent.Transparency = 0.2
				end

				local productNumber = tick()
				local secondaryNew = CFrame.new
				local product = productNumber * 2

				result.C0 = secondaryNew(0, 5.5 + math.sin(product) * 0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 3.141592653589793, 0)
				local number = productNumber * 3

				parent.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.1 * math.sin(number)
				local secondaryProduct = productNumber * 4

				part.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.1 * math.sin(secondaryProduct)
				local alternateProduct = productNumber * 5

				secondaryParent.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.1 * math.sin(alternateProduct)
				previousCapturedRunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
		end)
	end

	local optionData = conditionData
	local pairsFunction = pairs
	local secondaryData = packValues(Players:GetPlayers())

	for _, item in pairsFunction(unpack(secondaryData, 1, secondaryData.n)) do
		local capturedConditionData = conditionData
		local capturedPlayer = item

		local function createMickeyAura(parent)
			if parent then
				local HumanoidRootPart = parent:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

				if parent:FindFirstChild("MickeyAura") then
					parent.MickeyAura:Destroy()
				end

				local createMickeyAuraOption = capturedConditionData[capturedPlayer.Name]
					or capturedConditionData[capturedPlayer.DisplayName]

				if createMickeyAuraOption and createMickeyAuraOption.Style then
					local Model = Instance.new("Model", parent)

					Model.Name = "MickeyAura"

					if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "DIVINE_RING" then
						if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "HYDRA_STRIKE" then
							if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "DEMON_HANDS" then
								if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "HEART_AURA" then
									if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "LETTER_A" then
										if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "LETTER_N" then
											if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "NORMAL_HALO" then
												if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "ANGEL_WINGS" then
													if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "BIG_SNIPER" then
														if createMickeyAuraOption.Style == "ILLUMINATI" then
															outerCreateMickeyAuraPart(
																capturedPlayer,
																HumanoidRootPart,
																Model
															)
														end

														return
													end

													innerCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

													return
												end

												nestedCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

												return
											end

											fallbackCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

											return
										end

										additionalCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

										return
									end

									alternateCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

									return
								end

								createPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

								return
							end

							secondaryCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

							return
						end

						createHydraCore(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

						return
					end

					createMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

					return
				end

				return
			end
		end

		item.CharacterAdded:Connect(createMickeyAura)

		if item.Character then
			createMickeyAura(item.Character)
		end
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
		local capturedPlayer = player

		local function createMickeyAura(parent)
			if parent then
				local HumanoidRootPart = parent:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

				if parent:FindFirstChild("MickeyAura") then
					parent.MickeyAura:Destroy()
				end

				local createMickeyAuraOption = optionData[capturedPlayer.Name] or optionData[capturedPlayer.DisplayName]

				if createMickeyAuraOption and createMickeyAuraOption.Style then
					local Model = Instance.new("Model", parent)

					Model.Name = "MickeyAura"

					if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "DIVINE_RING" then
						if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "HYDRA_STRIKE" then
							if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "DEMON_HANDS" then
								if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "HEART_AURA" then
									if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "LETTER_A" then
										if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "LETTER_N" then
											if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "NORMAL_HALO" then
												if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "ANGEL_WINGS" then
													if createMickeyAuraOption.Style ~= "BIG_SNIPER" then
														if createMickeyAuraOption.Style == "ILLUMINATI" then
															outerCreateMickeyAuraPart(
																capturedPlayer,
																HumanoidRootPart,
																Model
															)
														end

														return
													end

													innerCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

													return
												end

												nestedCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

												return
											end

											fallbackCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

											return
										end

										additionalCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

										return
									end

									alternateCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

									return
								end

								createPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

								return
							end

							secondaryCreateMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

							return
						end

						createHydraCore(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

						return
					end

					createMickeyAuraPart(capturedPlayer, HumanoidRootPart, Model)

					return
				end

				return
			end
		end

		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(createMickeyAura)

		if player.Character then
			createMickeyAura(player.Character)
		end
	end)

	if not (data[LocalPlayer.Name] or false) then
		createTextButton(nil, "— Mickey Chat: Secure Edition with Database Secret —", nil, true)
	end

	return
end
